crossRefs.note: Those who ate the loaves were five thousand men.

parallels.note: Those who ate were about five thousand men, in addition to women and children.
For they were about five thousand men. He said to his disciples, “Make them sit down in groups of about fifty each.”

translations.web: Those who ate the loaves were five thousand men.
translations.bsb: And there were five thousand men who had eaten the loaves.
translations.kjv: And they that did eat of the loaves were about five thousand men.
translations.asv: And they that ate the loaves were five thousand men.
